content:
Following yesterday's wave of security-related updates, Apple today detailed the security contents of Safari 26.6.1. Here are the details.

Codex appears in multiple CVE credits

Apple today updated its "Apple Security Updates" page, detailing the vulnerability fixes included in Safari 26.6.1, which is now available for download on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia.

According to the documentation, this update addresses 22 CVEs, all related to WebKit, including two vulnerabilities where "processing maliciously crafted web content could lead to memory corruption."

Notably, as with recent security updates, OpenAI Codex Security appears nine times on the list, further highlighting the increasingly important role of AI tools in finding security vulnerabilities in Apple software.

Below is Apple's complete security content for Safari 26.6.1:

Safari 26.6.1 Released August 18, 2026 WebKit Available for: macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content could lead to an unexpected Safari crash Description: An out-of-bounds access issue was addressed by improved bounds checking. WebKit Bugzilla: 317632 CVE-2026-64784: Janggoon Lee of Out of Bounds, OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 313452 CVE-2026-43795: wwwlk WebKit Bugzilla: 318348 CVE-2026-65338: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content could lead to memory corruption WebKit Bugzilla: 318405 CVE-2026-65341: Henock Habte WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improved locking. WebKit Bugzilla: 321480 CVE-2026-64782: Seonwook Kim, Shubham Chaskar, lattice, Josef Korbel WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improved input validation. WebKit Bugzilla: 321484 CVE-2026-64781: Thomas Guillem WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 321517 CVE-2026-65351: Niels Hofmans WebKit Bugzilla: 316996 CVE-2026-65340: Claudio Bozzato and Francesco Benvenuto of Cisco Talos, Josef Korbel (Citadelo) WebKit Bugzilla: 317142 CVE-2026-65337: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317349 CVE-2026-65336: Josef Korbel WebKit Bugzilla: 316723 CVE-2026-65335: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317603 CVE-2026-65333: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317450 CVE-2026-65332: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317611 CVE-2026-65331: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content could lead to an unexpected app crash Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed by improved memory management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316347 CVE-2026-64715: Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improved checks. WebKit Bugzilla: 316918 CVE-2026-64780: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316791 CVE-2026-65334: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 317317 CVE-2026-43794: Dung Do (@_piers2) of Calif.io WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content could lead to an unexpected app termination WebKit Bugzilla: 313703 CVE-2026-64787: Sota Sugiyama, Shubham Chaskar WebKit Records Impact: Visiting a maliciously crafted website could leak sensitive data WebKit Bugzilla: 315528 CVE-2026-64778: Mohit Negi WebKit Storage WebKit Bugzilla: 321485 CVE-2026-64779: Shubham Chaskar, Tommy DeVoss (@thedawgyg) of the Braze Security Team Additional credits WebKit We would like to acknowledge Henock Habte for their assistance.
